title: Princeton random event generators affected by heart-centeredness

tellings.quote: Dirty Little Secret that like he's like yeah you know this is well known in reeg random event generator circles is that your heart centeredness is somehow commensurate with your ability to affect the output on the random event generator

plain: At a parapsychology lab at Princeton, a group that tested whether the mind can affect machines, people are said to have found that the more "heart-centered" a person is, the more they can sway the output of a random event generator, a device that spits out random numbers. Michels tells this as something a friend from that lab told him, a friend he does not name, who called it a "dirty little secret" well known among people who work with these machines. If true, it would mean that feeling, not just focus, has some effect on physical things.
